  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="Pool_Assembler" name="Assembler AG" processRef="Process_Order" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Order" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_1">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Assembler" name="Assembler AG">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Monthly</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveInvoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Done</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Supplier" name="Supplier">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendInvoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Monthly" name="First of each month">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="Timer_Monthly">
        <bpmn:timeCycle xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">0 0 0 1 * ?</bpmn:timeCycle>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendOrder" name="Send the order to the supplier">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessOrder" name="Process the order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendInvoice" name="Send the invoice to Assembler AG">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveInvoice" name="Receive the invoice">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Done" name="Invoice received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_Monthly" targetRef="Task_SendOrder" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_SendOrder" targetRef="Task_ProcessOrder" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveInvoice" targetRef="End_Done" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
